blurb: Guests can play PC games on high-performance rigs, consoles including PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo, tabletop games like D&D and Warhammer, and classic and modern arcade games. The center offers hourly gameplay with various gaming stations and hosts private events, birthday parties, and corporate team-building events. Food and drinks are available onsite, and the facility is ADA-compliant with free parking.
